name: Diabetes - HbA1c Recommendation
reason: HbA1c is essential for monitoring long-term blood sugar control in diabetic patients, especially when cardiovascular tests are ordered.

name: Diabetes - Kidney Function Recommendation
reason: Diabetes can affect kidney function over time. Regular kidney function monitoring is recommended for diabetic patients.

name: Hypertension - Kidney Function Recommendation
reason: High blood pressure can impact kidney health. Kidney function tests help monitor for hypertension-related kidney damage.

name: Heart Disease - Cardiac Panel Recommendation
reason: Patients with heart disease should have comprehensive cardiac monitoring including enzyme panels alongside lipid testing.

name: Heart Disease - ECG Recommendation
reason: Regular ECG monitoring is important for heart disease patients to detect arrhythmias or other cardiac abnormalities.

name: Thyroid Issues - Lipid Panel Recommendation
reason: Thyroid dysfunction can affect cholesterol levels. Lipid panel testing is recommended when thyroid issues are present.

name: Multiple Conditions - Comprehensive Metabolic Recommendation
reason: Patients with multiple chronic conditions on multiple medications should have liver function monitored regularly.

name: Age-Based - Vitamin D Recommendation
reason: Vitamin D deficiency is common, especially in older adults. Consider testing when basic metabolic panels are ordered.

name: Kidney Disease - Electrolyte Monitoring
reason: CKD patients require regular electrolyte monitoring to maintain proper balance and prevent complications.

name: Liver Disease - Metabolic Monitoring
reason: Liver disease can affect glucose and electrolyte metabolism. Comprehensive metabolic monitoring is recommended.
